gloss: to open; to establish; to set up

definitions.gloss: to open; to establish; to set up (a facility, service, or account)
definitions.explanation: To bring something newly into operation so that it is available for use — an office, a shelter, a bank account, a website, a phone line. The emphasis is on starting the service, not on constructing the building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}する。
⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}した。
examples.english: The city set up an evacuation shelter in the gymnasium.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}ける→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}することになった。
examples.english: It has been decided to set up a dedicated help desk to receive inquiries.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive; the thing opened takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. The plain noun ⟦{開設|かいせつ}→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧ is common in notices: ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}→開設：14595_kaisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{口座|こうざ}→口座：05419_kouza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}する: to open a bank account
- ⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}する: to set up an evacuation shelter
- ⟦ホームページ→ホームページ：05869_hoomupeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}する: to launch a website
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{開設|かいせつ}する: to open a service counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧: to found, establish — used of organizations and companies as legal entities
- ⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to open for business — of a shop or practice starting trade
- ⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open — the everyday verb, from doors to meetings
